This is the Kimera K39, an Italian hypercar that mixes Kimera’s Lancia-inspired DNA with a bespoke carbonfibre chassis and a 1000hp V8 from Koenigsegg! It's an all-new hypercar from the ground up, not a restomod, and while this particular yellow car is still very much a WIP-prototype, we’ve driven it at the Top Gear Test Track for a tantalising first taste…
